Name: Hat Hair Toggle
Author: mushymato
Description:
Toggle how hair is displayed under your current hat by right-clicking the hat equip slot (rebindable).

This mod is inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2847]Hats Won't Mess Up Hair[/url] but you manually change the display mode and it works on any vanilla and content patcher hat.

Whether your hat will actually hide your hair is a combination of the hat's properties and the hairstyle's metadata. This mod changes the hat's hair mode between one of 3:
[list]
[*]Hat Hair: use the hat specific hair[/*]
[*]Normal Hair: use the base hair[/*]
[*]No Hair: hides the hair completely[/*]
[/list]
The changed draw mode persists even when you take your hat off and even if you uninstall this mod, but it is reset to the base value if you put the hat into a dresser.

Additionally you can set a default mode to auto apply for any hat you equip.

[size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][font=Courier New]ToggleKey[/font]: Change the toggle key. Default is [font=Courier New]MouseRight[/font] and [font=Courier New]LeftStick[/font].[/*]
[/list]
